oversized.source: sparse zero file; admission limit check only

measurement.audio: CDP WebAudio lifetime events; only native string IDs retained; no AudioNode references
measurement.listeners: CDP Memory.getDOMCounters.jsEventListeners after HeapProfiler.collectGarbage and the same quiet boundary
measurement.workers: CDP Target.getTargets worker targets in the current isolated browser context
measurement.observers: Auxiliary observe/disconnect token count, not a retained-GC metric and not a growth gate
measurement.warmup: One complete generated-chart run, one retry cycle and one quit cycle; then three identical GC/quiet snapshots at the suspended menu boundary before 20 measured cycles

limitations: Synthetic original WAVs/planned motion; no camera/person/recognition
Muted headless software rendering; no audible-sync or GPU-performance claim
Forced GC/resource counts are lifecycle diagnostics, not release performance evidence
